factual_claims.claim: Management emphasized a conservative capital structure and predictable cash generation, aiming to sustain dividends and navigate geopolitical and market volatility through diversified, infrastructure anchored operations.

We will continue to contribute to society... Looking ahead, 2026 is unlikely to be a year of broad-based success... Infortar’s role is to keep a steady heading as the seas grow rougher... Our headquarters remain in Estonia... Infortar’s mission is to build a crisis-resilient and inflation-proof dividend aristocrat – today and for generations to come.'
